Who we are

Packaging built for the journey, not the shelf

Elite Industries has manufactured export packaging and material handling products in Surat since 1998 — the films, straps, seals and dunnage that keep a container's contents exactly where they were loaded.

Everything we make is specified against the leg it has to survive: monsoon humidity in the hold, the compression of a stack six pallets deep, and a set of hands at the far end that has never seen the load before. Retail packaging is designed to be looked at. Ours is designed to arrive.

We hold stock across ten product lines, ship to the port on the schedule the exporter gives us, and certify what we send.
